{{Top|leg|title=''Class-D'' annihilation}}
{{Quote|Class-D annihilation isn't death. It's an affront to life and the Living Force itself.|Obi-Wan Kenobi|<ref name="SkyeWalkers: A Clone Wars Story">''[[SkyeWalkers: A Clone Wars Story]]''</ref>}}
'''''Class-D'' annihilation''', also known as '''''Class-D'' disintegration''' or '''transcendental annihilation''', was the epitome of [[Disruptor/Legends|disruptor]] technology. Invented by the [[Fatalists of Plootark IX|fatalists]] of [[Plootark IX]], it caused the atomic
deletion of its target, breaking its chemical bonds. Since ''Class-D'' annihilation specifically targeted [[Midi-chlorian/Legends|midi-chlorians]], matter thus eradicated was said to disappear even from detection in [[The Force/Legends|the Force]]. For that reason, the [[Jedi Order/Legends|Jedi Order]] regarded ''Class-D'' annihilation as the ultimate affront to life and the [[Living Force/Legends|Living Force]]. By the [[Time/Legends|time]] of the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]], ''Class-D'' devices were outlawed under
galactic law.
